title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: How do I know if a product is in stock?
answer: Stock is displayed on the product page. "In stock" means the item is available for immediate dispatch. "Limited stock" means fewer than 5 units. "Out of stock" means no order is possible; you can request a restock alert.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Are the products new?
answer: Yes, all products sold by NovaShop are new and sealed, unless explicitly marked "refurbished" on the product page. Refurbished products benefit from a 6-month warranty and are clearly labelled.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Are the products compatible with Moroccan networks?
answer: The smartphones sold are compatible with the 2G, 3G and 4G bands of Moroccan operators. 5G compatibility depends on the model and the operator's coverage; it is stated on each product page.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Are the products genuine and covered by the manufacturer?
answer: Yes, NovaShop sources from approved distributors. Each product comes with an invoice and, where applicable, a manufacturer warranty card.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Can I see the product before buying?
answer: Yes, display units are available in the Casablanca, Rabat and Marrakech stores. Some high-demand models may not be on display; contact the store to check availability.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Do you offer advice on choosing a product?
answer: Yes. The online chat provides a recommendation based on your budget and usage. The category guides (CAT-01 to CAT-06) present the ranges, key features and use cases.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Will an out-of-stock product be restocked?
answer: Most stock-outs are restocked within 2 to 4 weeks. Enable the restock alert to be notified by email when the item is back. No deadline is guaranteed for end-of-life products.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Can I order a product that is not listed on the site?
answer: NovaShop does not offer special orders for individuals. Businesses may contact the sales department for volume requirements.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Are prices negotiable?
answer: No. Displayed prices are fixed, except for ongoing promotional campaigns. Stores apply the same prices as the website, excluding delivery fees.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Are accessories included?
answer: The box contents are stated on each product page. Generally: device, charging cable, documentation. The power adapter and earphones are not always included, depending on the manufacturer.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: Can I test a product before returning it?
answer: A product may be tried out to check that it works, but significant use may make a change-of-mind return impossible. Test without removing protective films and keep the packaging.

title: FAQ — Products, stock and buying advice
question: How do I report an error on a product page?
answer: Use the "Report an error" link on the page, or contact support stating the product identifier. A correction is made within 5 business days.
